I’m unable to determine the structure and provide a SMILES string without any experimental information about the sample. Could you please share any of the following data for the compound?

- ¹H NMR spectrum (chemical‑shift values, multiplicities, integration)  
- ¹³C NMR spectrum (chemical‑shift values)  
- IR spectrum (key absorption bands)  
- Mass‑spectrometry data (molecular‑ion m/z and notable fragments)  
- A brief description of the compound (physical state, odor, known functional groups, etc.)

With that information I can analyze the sample and give you the correct SMILES notation.
